import unittest


def flip_case(string: str) -> str:
    return string.swapcase()


# Unit test for function flip_case
def test_flip_case():
    # Basic cases
    assert flip_case("Hello") == "hELLO"
    assert flip_case("WORLD") == "world"
    assert flip_case("PyThOn") == "pYtHoN"

    # Mixed with digits and punctuation
    assert flip_case("Hello, World! 123") == "hELLO, wORLD! 123"

    # Edge cases
    assert flip_case("") == ""
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    assert flip_case("A") == "a"
    assert flip_case("12345") == "12345"
    assert flip_case("!@#$%") == "!@#$%"

    # Unicode characters
    assert flip_case("ÑOño") == "ñOÑO"
    assert flip_case("ÜBER") == "über"

    # Double flip returns original
    for s in ["Hello", "WORLD", "PyThOn 123"]:
        assert flip_case(flip_case(s)) == s

    # Whitespace preservation
    assert flip_case(" a B c ") == " A b C "

    print("All tests passed!")


class TestFlipCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("Hello"), "hELLO")
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("WORLD"), "world")
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("PyThOn"), "pYtHoN")

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case(""), "")

    def test_single_char(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("a"), "A")
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("A"), "a")

    def test_non_alpha(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("123!@#"), "123!@#")

    def test_mixed(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("Hello, World! 123"), "hELLO, wORLD! 123")

    def test_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case(" a B c "), " A b C ")

    def test_unicode(self):
        self.assertEqual(flip_case("ÑOño"), "ñOÑO")

    def test_involution(self):
        for s in ["Hello", "WORLD", "PyThOn 123"]:
            self.assertEqual(flip_case(flip_case(s)), s)
